purpose: ADR-074 (04.10.2026): the municipality a question asks about is not where the person lives. In the live questionnaire of 04.10.2026 a question about another municipality, asked after the user had said where they live, was searched in the municipality of residence (Q3, Q5: docs/audits/rag-v2-live-questionnaire-2026-10-04.md). The asked municipality is now the turn's source scope, a follow-up goes on with it, and the saved residence stays as it was. Written before any run with the model; never run paid when written. Run with --auto-modes (what the chat sends).

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn (the catalogue and the knowledge lane's municipal texts): the asked municipality in a question about another one and in its follow-up, the residence otherwise
expectation_help.person_regions / state_kept: the saved dialogue state: each person's own municipality is unchanged by a question about another municipality, and the model's new state was not rejected
expectation_help.evidence: search: a source of the asked municipality is among the found sources
expectation_help.must / must_not / clarification: answer: it speaks of the asked service, does not turn the asked municipality's service into the user's own entitlement and does not say that its local information is about the municipality of residence; read the whole answer as well, a pattern is a coarse check

history: 04.10.2026, first run (commit a88dfe78, #344): the catalogue as written before any run, 8 turns: 7 passed, 0.0476 USD. The follow-up ("Ja mis see maksab?") failed its region check (docs/audits/evidence/question-region-measured-2026-10-04.json).

04.10.2026, second run (commit ae7703fd, #346): the first conversation only, 4 turns: 3 passed, 0.0218 USD. The follow-up passed. The question about Maardu failed clarification=false: its answer gave Maardu's service and conditions and then asked whether the service is for the user, who lives in Nõo vald, or for someone else (docs/audits/evidence/question-region-followup-measured-2026-10-04.json).

04.10.2026, after the second run: clarification=false was taken off that turn. It was written against the fault of 04.10 (a question back instead of the asked municipality's information); an answer that gives the information and then asks for a circumstance the regulation makes decisive is not that fault. In its place must_not names the fault itself. tests/rag-v2-question-region.test.mjs keeps both answers: the one of the second run passes the changed checks, the one of 04.10 does not. No run has been made with the changed check.

scenarios.title: Elab Nõo vallas, küsib Maardu teenuse kohta

turns.text: Elan Nõo vallas ja mul on raske toime tulla. Kust ma abi saan?
Kas Maardus saab isikliku abistaja teenust?
turns.note: 04.10 (Q5): the catalogue was Nõo vald's and the answer asked back ("Siin on kohalik info Nõo valla kohta"). As a first message (R5) the answer came from Maardu's regulation and gave the condition of registered residence in Maardu linn. must_not: the answer does not make the service the user's entitlement and does not say its local information is about the residence. A question back about whom the service is for is allowed (see history).
Codex F1: the follow-up names no municipality; the search goes on with the asked one when the plan's queries are still about it, and the residence stays Nõo vald.

turns.text: Aga millist koduteenust ma ise saan?
turns.note: The residence is the scope again: the request is about the user, and the plan's queries are no longer about the asked municipality.

turns.text: Elan Nõo vallas, töötan Maardus. Millist koduteenust ma saan?
turns.note: A named municipality does not win by being named: the place of work is another mention and the request is about the user's own help.

scenarios.title: Kasutaja Anija vallas, ema Kose vallas, küsimus Tartu valla kohta

turns.text: Elan Anija vallas ja mul on raha otsas. Kellele ma saan helistada?
Mu ema elab Kose vallas ja vajab koduteenust. Kuidas seda taotleda ja kelle poole pöörduda?
Kas Tartu vallas on sotsiaaltransport ja mis see maksab?
turns.note: 04.10 (Q3): the catalogue was Anija vald's and the answer stayed general. As a first message (R3) it named Tartu vald's own prices; those were not checked against the source.
